page_title: MON 3-0 LEN | Monaco v Lens 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Eliot Matazo (Monaco) in, Youssouf Fofana out.
89' Fouls committed – 21:16.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
86' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kevin Danso (Lens).
85' Takumi Minamino will be replaced by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
85' Adi Hutter prepares a substitution. Vanderson is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
82' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 6:1.
81' Willy Delajod interrupts the game. One of the players from Monaco won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
78' The yellow card is received by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
76' Monaco concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
74' Substitution. Mohamed Camara will be replaced by Denis Zakaria (Monaco).
74' Substitution. Folarin Balogun (Monaco) replaces Wissam Ben Yedder.
72' That will be all from Adrien Thomasson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ayanda Sishuba (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that Angelo Fulgini can be given a rest.
71' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Elye Wahi will be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
70' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Willy Delajod has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
66' Andy Diouf (Lens) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Willy Delajod no option but to blow his whistle.
64' Facundo Medina (Lens) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Willy Delajod ignores the protests.
59' 3 - 0 Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) manages to rise above the opponent's defenders to meet the well-taken corner kick with his head. His effort goes inside the right post. What a finish!
59' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the corner.
57' Substitution. Andy Diouf (Lens) on for Stijn Spierings.
57' 57:43 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
52' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Vanderson (Monaco), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
50' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
47' Booking. Mohamed Camara (Monaco) receives a caution from the referee.
47' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call. Lens are awarded the free kick.
46' Franck Haise makes a half-time substitution. Deiver Machado (Lens) comes on in place of Massadio Haidara.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' A player from Lens commits a rough challenge. Willy Delajod blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

43' Massadio Haidara (Lens) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Willy Delajod with no other option than to blow for a foul.
42' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
39' Massadio Haidara (Lens) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
36' 2 - 0 Goal! Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 2:0. He was ably assisted there by Takumi Minamino.
35' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) strikes the ball from the direct free kick, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save.
33' The foul by Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Willy Delajod.
32' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Monaco was in an offside position.
30' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
29' The linesman signals that Elye Wahi (Lens) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
28' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement.
27' Willy Delajod couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Mohamed Camara (Monaco) and blew his whistle.
26' Rough tackle by Salis Abdul Samed (Lens). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' 1 - 0 Stephane Singo (Monaco) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
24' Monaco force a corner. They send men into the box.

24' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Brice Samba stops the ball from going into the top of the net. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
23' Stijn Spierings (Lens) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
22' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is adjudged offside.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
18' Willy Delajod blows for a foul after Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
15' The Monaco players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Caio Henrique (Monaco) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! A free kick is awarded to Lens.
11' The players claim that Elye Wahi (Lens) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. Monaco have a free kick.
10' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Brice Samba expertly pushes away.
9' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Brice Samba easily deals with the threat.
7' The game is interrupted now, Massadio Haidara (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
6' Guillermo Maripan (Monaco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Half-chance! Florian Sotoca (Lens) plays a pass into the box, but Philipp Kohn reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Monaco will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod will officiate today.
